pr_title: executor: add JSON opaque value condition to everywhere
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: YangKeao <yangkeao@chunibyo.icu>

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #37387 

Problem Summary:

Cast the json opaque value to other types will cause `ERROR 1105 (HY000): Unknown type code in JSON`

### What is changed and how it works?

Add the JSON opaque value to the places where we haven't exhausted all TypeCode.

The tikv implementation of json opaque doesn't have this issue, as it cannot be compiled if I didn't exhaust every condition.

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [ ] Unit test
- [ ] Integration test
- [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
- [ ] No code

```
select cast(json_extract(json_objectagg('a', b'010101'), '$.a') as SIGNED);
```

### Release note

<!-- compatibility change, improvement, bugfix, and new feature need a release note -->

Please refer to [Release Notes Language Style Guide](https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/release-notes-style-guide.html) to write a quality release note.

```release-note
Fix the issue that the json opaque value cannot be casted to other types.
```

issue_context.title: Support convert to other type from json opaque value
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Converting to other types are still not supported for json opaque value.

I should check every places where the `match TypeCode` happens to see whether the types are exhausted.

review_comments: I added a test in the codec, and it's covered now :beers: .
